2

Haba ngi im kumne mynta, u soh u pai

la pyniaryngkat kyrdan bad kiwei pat ki jaid- 
bynriew jong ka Ri India, bad haba dei ruh 
pynpalat kyrdan ban ia ki.

Dang bun lehse kiei kiei kiba ia dei bad ka 
History jong-i kiba nga khlem da lah ban buh

may, “Ban iathuh ia ka history shaphang jong 
u shitaieu ruh kam lah kut satia’*. * Hynrei nga 
kyrmen ba ki paralok kiba pule ia kane ka jing-

II

la i Babu Jeebon Roy la kha ha Sohra ha 
Saitsohpen ha ka snem 1838. I kpa jong i i dei 
U Ram Sing Korkata, u nongkhaii. Kat kum 
ka jingiathuh i khun nyngkong jong i Babu Jee- 
bon Roy, i Sib Charan Roy, “balei la sin U Ram 
Sing Korkata ka long na ka dau ba ma u bad U 
Rangbah Bi Tham ki la long kiba nyngkong eh 
kiba leit shong skul sha Korkata ha Serampore 
ba ialam U Sahep Baptist”. ®

I kmie jong u Ram Sing dei i Tira Rani ne 
Jaid Rani na shaphang Khadsawphra. Na ki 
dulir jaka ngi tip ba i long i briew iba don ba 
kot bad i don khyndew Zamindari shapoh Sylhet

4

E)istrict kiba la kyntiew kyrteng “Tira Rani 
Rhasiani” ha ki Revenue Register. I shait sah 
ruh ha kine ki jaka jong i kiba hap hapoh Kala- 
sadok Mouza namar ba i Babu Jeebon Roy i ong, 
“Nga shait leit sah bad i meikha ha Kalasadok la 
jan man ka snem ha ka por tlang”.

I kpa jong i Babu Jeebon Roy, u Ram Sing, 
i la leit shongkha shuwa ha ki jaid Jana. Hynrei 
badien ba i la ioh khun uwei, i kmie jong i i la 
phah iaphet noh namar ba paw ki dak ki shin 
ba yn nym shem bha ka iing ka sem lada sah 
hangta. Hadien ba i la ia phet noh na ki jaid 
Jana, U Ram Singh, i kpa i Babu Jeebon Roy i 
sa shongkurim pat ia i Bijan Laitkynsew. I Bijan 
i dei i ba na Sheila, i jaid Mairom bad i khunkha 
ki Majau na Laitkynsew. I ioh khun lai ngut, 
i Jeebon Roy, i Bon Roy bad i kynthei, i Tiwbon.

I Babu Jeebon Roy im shym ioh >a ka jing- 
myntoi na ka shong skul namar ha ka por ba i 
dang khynnah ma i ka jinghikai skul ha Ri Khasi 
ka dang shu sdang. Ynda rangbah i la shong 
kurim ia i Lakreh, i ksiew jong i Lyngksiar Soh- 
iong Jaid Dkhar Sawian bad u Dewan Sing 
Diengdoh, uba long uwei na ki nongkhaii bah na 
Sohra kiba leit khaii shaduh Komila, Dacca and 
Calcutta.

I Babu Jeebon Roy i la rung kam Sdrkar ha

Special Commissioner ha ka por Thma' Jaintia. 
I la kiew kam pat kum u Second Grade Sub- 
Inspector of Police ha ka 16th September 1862. 
Ha ka 1st June 1875 i la long Second Grade 
Inspector of Police. Ha ka 3rd December 1877 
i la wan sha Shillong kum u Officiating E. A. C., 
5th Grade, Khasi and Jaintia Hills. Naduh ka 
2nd December 1879 i la trei kum u 2nd Class 
Magistrate bad kum u Superintendent of Shil- 
long Jail naduh ka 11th March 1880.1 la Uei 
ruh kum u Sub-Registrar of Shillong naduh 
ka 5th November 1 878 haduh ka 9th January 
1880. I Babu Jeebon Roy i la retire kum u 
Senior Extra Assistant Commissioner ha ka 
20th November 1894 bad ka Sorkar ka la ai 
pension Rs. 200/- (ar spah tyngka) shi bnai.

VI

T Babu Jeebon Roy i kwah ia ki para Khasi 
ba kin sngewjan ka jingiadei parabriew hapoh

bha, bad ban ioh pule la dang khynnah.”

I shait pynshlur ia ki para Khasi ba kin mih 
na la shnong ban leit shang kylleng ban ioh-i ia 
kijingimbadjingphylla ha ki ri-nongwei. I la 
ialam kawei ka kynhun Khasi sha Calcutta Exhi-

“Ha ka por une u Lord Saheb (Marquis 
Ripon) la long ka Exhibition ha Calcutta, ba la 
wan p<M noh baroh saw-dong ka pyrthei ki kynja 
bynriew. Nga nangne na ri Khasi, nga leit ialam 
bun ki Khasi; u Syiem Klur Singh jong ka 
Khyrim Tenitory ruh u ialeit.”

“An excellent collection of agricultural

together with samples of the gold and silver 
jewellery of the Khasis, were purchased by Pro-

Court. Babu Jiban Rai took down to Calcutta 
a party of 3 Khasis and 3 Santengs (one man and 
two women of each tribe), whose models in clay, 
dressed in the national costume, now form pttrt 
of the ethnological collection in the CalQutta
